name: Auburn 851 SC Speedster 1935
description:
1935 Auburn 851 Supercharged Boattail Speedster, Gordon Buehrig's last Auburn. Lycoming GH straight-eight, 279.9 cu in, Schwitzer-Cummins centrifugal supercharger: 150 bhp at 4000 rpm, 232 lb-ft at 2800. Three-speed gearbox and the Columbia Dual-Ratio axle, Lockheed hydraulic drums, beam axles on semi-elliptic springs, 6.50-16 whitewalls on wire wheels, 3765 lb. Every car carried Ab Jenkins' dash plaque: driven over 100 mph before shipment.

DUAL-RATIO AXLE (needs Custom Shaders Patch 0.2.11 or newer): the car starts in HIGH (3.06). Press Extra A (CSP default Alt+Numpad 7; bind it in Content Manager > Settings > Assetto Corsa > Controls > Patch, group Car (extras)) to preselect LOW (4.50) - the lever on the steering-wheel hub swings over - then press the clutch or change gear below 40 mph and the axle shifts, as the real vacuum shift did. Press Extra A again for HIGH. The gear display shows 1H, 2L... Without Extra A the car simply stays in high and drives fine.

The base model was reworked part by part to photographs of surviving cars: V grille with the 851 figures, Flying Goddess mascot and side emblems, V windscreen with spot lamps and a working mirror, louvred hood with four flex exhaust pipes, dipped bumpers, boattail with its chrome spear, welded wire wheels, doors that open, pleated leather bench, the two-pod dash with working gauges, and a full underside. Own straight-eight engine sound and ahooga horn. 14 skins in 1935-36 Auburn colours with period leather.

3D model: "1935 Auburn 851 SC Speedster" by Kryox Shade (https://sketchfab.com/kryoxshade), CC BY 4.0 - https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/1935-auburn-851-sc-speedster-c8987d3ff4ba4aa4bc8d7cde74bb2ccd - reworked by Street Corsa Mods.
Port, rework, physics, sound, gauges and skins: Street Corsa Mods - https://streetcorsamods.com/
Horn: "Old Car Ahooga Horn" by craigsmith (Freesound 480002, CC0). Driver pose, animations and collider box: Kunos Simulazioni.
This mod is open to anybody who wants to improve it: https://sourceforge.net/p/streetcorsa-mods/auburn-851-sc-speedster-boattail-1935/
